sql_text: SELECT p_partkey, p_name, p_retailprice, AVG(ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM part JOIN partsupp ON p_partkey = ps_partkey WHERE ps_availqty <= 500 GROUP BY p_partkey, p_name, p_retailprice HAVING p_retailprice < AVG(ps_supplycost);
SELECT o_clerk, COUNT(*) AS urgent_orders FROM orders WHERE o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') GROUP BY o_clerk ORDER BY urgent_orders DESC LIMIT 15;
SELECT o_clerk, COUNT(*) AS urgent_orders FROM orders WHERE o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') GROUP BY o_clerk ORDER BY urgent_orders ASC LIMIT 15;
SELECT o_clerk, COUNT(*) AS urgent_orders FROM orders WHERE o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' GROUP BY o_clerk ORDER BY urgent_orders DESC LIMIT 15;
SELECT o_clerk, COUNT(*) AS urgent_orders FROM orders WHERE o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH', '3-MEDIUM') GROUP BY o_clerk ORDER BY urgent_orders DESC LIMIT 15;
SELECT o_clerk, SUM(o_totalprice) AS urgent_revenue FROM orders WHERE o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') GROUP BY o_clerk ORDER BY urgent_revenue DESC LIMIT 15;
SELECT o_clerk, COUNT(*) AS urgent_orders FROM orders WHERE o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY o_clerk ORDER BY urgent_orders DESC LIMIT 15;
SELECT o_clerk, COUNT(*) AS urgent_orders FROM orders WHERE o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND o_orderdate <= DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o_clerk ORDER BY urgent_orders DESC LIMIT 15;
SELECT o_clerk, COUNT(*) AS all_orders FROM orders GROUP BY o_clerk ORDER BY all_orders DESC LIMIT 15;
SELECT o_clerk, AVG(o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM orders WHERE o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') GROUP BY o_clerk ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC LIMIT 15;
SELECT o_clerk, COUNT(*) AS urgent_orders FROM orders WHERE o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND o_totalprice > 100000 GROUP BY o_clerk ORDER BY urgent_orders DESC LIMIT 15;
SELECT o_clerk, COUNT(*) AS urgent_orders FROM orders WHERE o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') AND o_totalprice <= 100000 GROUP BY o_clerk ORDER BY urgent_orders DESC LIMIT 15;
SELECT p_size, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS discounted_revenue FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey GROUP BY p_size ORDER BY p_size;
SELECT p_size, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS discounted_revenue FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey GROUP BY p_size ORDER BY discounted_revenue DESC;
SELECT p_size, AVG(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS avg_revenue FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey GROUP BY p_size ORDER BY p_size;
SELECT p_size, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey GROUP BY p_size ORDER BY p_size;
SELECT p_size, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS discounted_revenue FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY p_size ORDER BY p_size;
SELECT p_size, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS discounted_revenue FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey WHERE l_shipdate <= DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY p_size ORDER BY p_size;
SELECT p_size, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS discounted_revenue FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey WHERE p_size > 10 GROUP BY p_size ORDER BY p_size;
SELECT p_size, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS discounted_revenue FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey WHERE p_size <= 10 GROUP BY p_size ORDER BY p_size;
SELECT p_size, SUM(l_extendedprice) AS gross_revenue, SUM(l_extendedprice * l_discount) AS total_discount FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey GROUP BY p_size ORDER BY p_size;
SELECT p_size, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS discounted_revenue FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey WHERE l_discount < 0.05 GROUP BY p_size ORDER BY p_size;

SELECT p_size, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS discounted_revenue FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey WHERE l_discount >= 0.05 GROUP BY p_size ORDER BY discounted_revenue DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT s_suppkey, s_name FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_nationkey = s.s_nationkey;

SELECT DISTINCT s_suppkey, s_name FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_nationkey = s.s_nationkey AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01';

SELECT DISTINCT s_suppkey, s_name FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_nationkey = s.s_nationkey AND o.o_orderdate <= DATE '1997-12-31';

SELECT DISTINCT s_suppkey, s_name FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_nationkey != s.s_nationkey;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s_suppkey) AS same_nation_suppliers FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_nationkey = s.s_nationkey;

SELECT n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s_suppkey) AS same_nation_supplier_count FROM nation JOIN supplier s ON n_nationkey = s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n_name ORDER BY same_nation_supplier_count DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT s_suppkey, s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY s_suppkey, s_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT DISTINCT s_suppkey, s_name FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_nationkey = s.s_nationkey AND o.o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT';

SELECT DISTINCT c_custkey, c_name FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE c.c_nationkey = s.s_nationkey;

SELECT DISTINCT s_suppkey, s_name FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_nationkey = s.s_nationkey AND o.o_totalprice > 150000;

SELECT DISTINCT s_suppkey, s_name FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_nationkey = s.s_nationkey AND o.o_totalprice <= 150000;
SELECT o_shippriority, AVG(o_totalprice) AS avg_total, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY o_shippriority;
SELECT o_shippriority, AVG(o_totalprice) AS avg_total, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY o_shippriority ORDER BY avg_total DESC;
SELECT o_shippriority, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY o_shippriority ORDER BY o_shippriority;
SELECT o_shippriority, MAX(o_totalprice) AS max_price, MIN(o_totalprice) AS min_price FROM orders GROUP BY o_shippriority;
SELECT o_shippriority, AVG(o_totalprice) AS avg_total, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY o_shippriority;
SELECT o_shippriority, AVG(o_totalprice) AS avg_total, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate <= DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o_shippriority;
SELECT o_shippriority, o_orderpriority, AVG(o_totalprice) AS avg_total FROM orders GROUP BY o_shippriority, o_orderpriority ORDER BY o_shippriority;
SELECT o_shippriority, AVG(o_totalprice) AS avg_total FROM orders WHERE o_totalprice > 100000 GROUP BY o_shippriority;
SELECT o_shippriority, AVG(o_totalprice) AS avg_total FROM orders WHERE o_totalprice <= 100000 GROUP BY o_shippriority;
SELECT o_shippriority, STDDEV(o_totalprice) AS price_stddev FROM orders GROUP BY o_shippriority;
SELECT c_mktsegment, o_shippriority, AVG(o_totalprice) AS avg_total FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY c_mktsegment, o_shippriority ORDER BY c_mktsegment, o_shippriority;
SELECT l_orderkey, l_linenumber, l_discount, l_tax FROM lineitem WHERE l_discount >= l_tax LIMIT 100;
SELECT l_orderkey, l_linenumber, l_discount, l_tax FROM lineitem WHERE l_discount <= l_tax LIMIT 100;
SELECT l_orderkey, l_linenumber, l_discount, l_tax FROM lineitem WHERE l_discount > l_tax LIMIT 100;
SELECT l_orderkey, l_linenumber, l_discount, l_tax FROM lineitem WHERE l_discount = l_tax LIMIT 100;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_discount_lines FROM lineitem WHERE l_discount >= l_tax;
SELECT l_shipmode, COUNT(*) AS high_discount_count FROM lineitem WHERE l_discount >= l_tax GROUP BY l_shipmode ORDER BY high_discount_count DESC;
SELECT l_orderkey, l_linenumber, l_discount, l_tax, (l_discount - l_tax) AS diff FROM lineitem WHERE l_discount >= l_tax ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 100;
SELECT l_orderkey, l_linenumber, l_discount, l_tax FROM lineitem WHERE l_discount >= l_tax AND l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' LIMIT 100;
SELECT l_orderkey, l_linenumber, l_discount, l_tax FROM lineitem WHERE l_discount >= l_tax AND l_shipdate <= DATE '1997-12-31' LIMIT 100;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, COUNT(*) AS high_discount_count FROM lineitem WHERE l_discount >= l_tax GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr;
SELECT l_returnflag, COUNT(*) AS high_discount_count FROM lineitem WHERE l_discount >= l_tax GROUP BY l_returnflag;

WITH yearly_revenue AS ( SELECT r_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS yr, SUM(o_totalprice) AS revenue FROM region JOIN nation ON r_regionkey = n_regionkey JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY r_name, yr ) SELECT r_name, yr, revenue, LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY r_name ORDER BY yr) AS prev_revenue, ROUND( 100.0 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY r_name ORDER BY yr)) / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY r_name ORDER BY yr), 0), 2 ) AS yoy_growth_pct FROM yearly_revenue ORDER BY r_name, yr;

WITH nation_yr AS ( SELECT n_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS yr, SUM(o_totalprice) AS revenue FROM nation JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY n_name, yr ) SELECT n_name, yr, revenue, LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY n_name ORDER BY yr) AS prev_yr, ROUND(100.0*(revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY n_name ORDER BY yr)) / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY n_name ORDER BY yr),0),2) AS yoy_pct FROM nation_yr ORDER BY n_name, yr;

WITH seg_yr AS ( SELECT c_mktsegment, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS yr, SUM(o_totalprice) AS revenue FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY c_mktsegment, yr ) SELECT c_mktsegment, yr, revenue, LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY c_mktsegment ORDER BY yr) AS prev_yr, ROUND(100.0*(revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY c_mktsegment ORDER BY yr)) / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY c_mktsegment ORDER BY yr),0),2) AS yoy_pct FROM seg_yr ORDER BY c_mktsegment, yr;

WITH qtr_data AS ( SELECT r_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS yr, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM o_orderdate) AS qtr, SUM(o_totalprice) AS revenue FROM region JOIN nation ON r_regionkey=n_regionkey JOIN customer ON n_nationkey=c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey=o_custkey GROUP BY r_name, yr, qtr ) SELECT r_name, yr, qtr, revenue, LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY r_name, qtr ORDER BY yr) AS same_qtr_prev_yr, ROUND(100.0*(revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY r_name, qtr ORDER BY yr)) / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY r_name, qtr ORDER BY yr),0),2) AS yoy_pct FROM qtr_data ORDER BY r_name, yr, qtr;

WITH sup_yr AS ( SELECT r_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, SUM(l_extendedprice*(1-l_discount)) AS revenue FROM region JOIN nation ON r_regionkey=n_regionkey JOIN supplier ON n_nationkey=s_nationkey JOIN lineitem ON s_suppkey=l_suppkey GROUP BY r_name, yr ) SELECT r_name, yr, revenue, LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY r_name ORDER BY yr) AS prev_yr, ROUND(100.0*(revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY r_name ORDER BY yr)) / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY r_name ORDER BY yr),0),2) AS yoy_pct FROM sup_yr ORDER BY r_name, yr;

WITH cnt_yr AS ( SELECT r_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS yr, COUNT(DISTINCT o_orderkey) AS order_cnt FROM region JOIN nation ON r_regionkey=n_regionkey JOIN customer ON n_nationkey=c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey=o_custkey GROUP BY r_name, yr ) SELECT r_name, yr, order_cnt, LAG(order_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY r_name ORDER BY yr) AS prev_yr_cnt, ROUND(100.0*(order_cnt - LAG(order_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY r_name ORDER BY yr)) / NULLIF(LAG(order_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY r_name ORDER BY yr),0),2) AS yoy_pct FROM cnt_yr ORDER BY r_name, yr;

WITH yr_rev AS ( SELECT r_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS yr, SUM(o_totalprice) AS revenue FROM region JOIN nation ON r_regionkey=n_regionkey JOIN customer ON n_nationkey=c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey=o_custkey GROUP BY r_name, yr ) SELECT r_name, yr, revenue, SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY r_name ORDER BY yr ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_revenue FROM yr_rev ORDER BY r_name, yr;

WITH yr_rev AS ( SELECT r_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS yr, SUM(o_totalprice) AS revenue FROM region JOIN nation ON r_regionkey=n_regionkey JOIN customer ON n_nationkey=c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey=o_custkey GROUP BY r_name, yr ) SELECT r_name, yr, revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY yr ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rank_in_year, ROUND(100.0*revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY yr),2) AS pct_of_year_total FROM yr_rev ORDER BY yr, rank_in_year;

WITH avg_yr AS ( SELECT r_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS yr, AVG(o_totalprice) AS avg_order_val FROM region JOIN nation ON r_regionkey=n_regionkey JOIN customer ON n_nationkey=c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey=o_custkey GROUP BY r_name, yr ) SELECT r_name, yr, ROUND(avg_order_val,2) AS avg_order_val, ROUND(LAG(avg_order_val) OVER (PARTITION BY r_name ORDER BY yr),2) AS prev_yr_avg, ROUND(100.0*(avg_order_val - LAG(avg_order_val) OVER (PARTITION BY r_name ORDER BY yr)) / NULLIF(LAG(avg_order_val) OVER (PARTITION BY r_name ORDER BY yr),0),2) AS yoy_pct FROM avg_yr ORDER BY r_name, yr;

WITH yr_rev AS ( SELECT r_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS yr, SUM(o_totalprice) AS revenue FROM region JOIN nation ON r_regionkey=n_regionkey JOIN customer ON n_nationkey=c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey=o_custkey GROUP BY r_name, yr ) SELECT r_name, yr, revenue, LEAD(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY r_name ORDER BY yr) AS next_yr_revenue, ROUND(100.0*(LEAD(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY r_name ORDER BY yr) - revenue) / NULLIF(revenue,0),2) AS next_yr_growth_pct FROM yr_rev ORDER BY r_name, yr;

WITH net_yr AS ( SELECT r_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, SUM(l_extendedprice*(1-l_discount)*(1+l_tax)) AS net_revenue FROM region JOIN nation ON r_regionkey=n_regionkey JOIN supplier ON n_nationkey=s_nationkey JOIN lineitem ON s_suppkey=l_suppkey GROUP BY r_name, yr ) SELECT r_name, yr, ROUND(net_revenue,2) AS net_revenue, ROUND(LAG(net_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY r_name ORDER BY yr),2) AS prev_yr, ROUND(100.0*(net_revenue - LAG(net_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY r_name ORDER BY yr)) / NULLIF(LAG(net_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY r_name ORDER BY yr),0),2) AS yoy_pct FROM net_yr ORDER BY r_name, yr;

WITH customer_value AS ( SELECT c_custkey, c_name, c_nationkey, SUM(o_totalprice) AS lifetime_value, COUNT(o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name, c_nationkey ) SELECT cv.*, n_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c_nationkey ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC) AS nation_rank FROM customer_value cv JOIN nation ON cv.c_nationkey = n_nationkey ORDER BY c_nationkey, nation_rank LIMIT 100;

WITH clv AS ( SELECT c_custkey, c_name, c_nationkey, SUM(o_totalprice) AS lifetime_value, COUNT(o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey=o_custkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name, c_nationkey ) SELECT clv.c_custkey, clv.c_name, n_name, clv.lifetime_value, clv.total_orders, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c_nationkey ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC) AS nation_rank FROM clv JOIN nation ON clv.c_nationkey=n_nationkey ORDER BY c_nationkey, nation_rank LIMIT 100;

WITH clv AS ( SELECT c_custkey, c_name, c_nationkey, SUM(o_totalprice) AS lifetime_value, COUNT(o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey=o_custkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name, c_nationkey ) SELECT clv.c_custkey, clv.c_name, n_name, clv.lifetime_value, clv.total_orders, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c_nationkey ORDER BY total_orders DESC) AS order_count_rank FROM clv JOIN nation ON clv.c_nationkey=n_nationkey ORDER BY c_nationkey, order_count_rank LIMIT 100;

WITH clv AS ( SELECT c_custkey, c_name, c_nationkey, SUM(o_totalprice) AS lifetime_value FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey=o_custkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name, c_nationkey ) SELECT clv.c_custkey, clv.c_name, r_name, clv.lifetime_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r_regionkey ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC) AS region_rank FROM clv JOIN nation ON clv.c_nationkey=n_nationkey JOIN region ON n_regionkey=r_regionkey ORDER BY r_name, region_rank LIMIT 100;

WITH clv AS ( SELECT c_custkey, c_name, c_nationkey, c_mktsegment, SUM(o_totalprice) AS lifetime_value FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey=o_custkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name, c_nationkey, c_mktsegment ) SELECT clv.c_custkey, clv.c_name, clv.c_mktsegment, clv.lifetime_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c_mktsegment ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC) AS seg_rank FROM clv JOIN nation ON clv.c_nationkey=n_nationkey ORDER BY c_mktsegment, seg_rank LIMIT 100;

WITH clv AS ( SELECT c_custkey, c_name, c_nationkey, SUM(o_totalprice) AS lifetime_value FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey=o_custkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name, c_nationkey ), ranked AS ( SELECT clv.c_custkey, clv.c_name, n_name, clv.lifetime_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c_nationkey ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC) AS nation_rank FROM clv JOIN nation ON clv.c_nationkey=n_nationkey ) SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE nation_rank <= 5 ORDER BY n_name, nation_rank;

WITH clv AS ( SELECT c_custkey, c_nationkey, SUM(o_totalprice) AS lifetime_value FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey=o_custkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_nationkey ) SELECT n_name, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, ROUND(AVG(lifetime_value),2) AS avg_lifetime_value, ROUND(MAX(lifetime_value),2) AS max_lifetime_value, ROUND(MIN(lifetime_value),2) AS min_lifetime_value FROM clv JOIN nation ON clv.c_nationkey=n_nationkey GROUP BY n_name ORDER BY avg_lifetime_value DESC;

WITH clv AS ( SELECT c_custkey, c_name, c_nationkey, SUM(o_totalprice) AS lifetime_value FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey=o_custkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name, c_nationkey ) SELECT clv.c_custkey, clv.c_name, n_name, clv.lifetime_value, ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c_nationkey ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC)*100,2) AS top_pct FROM clv JOIN nation ON clv.c_nationkey=n_nationkey ORDER BY c_nationkey, top_pct LIMIT 100;

WITH clv AS ( SELECT c_custkey, c_name, c_nationkey, SUM(o_totalprice) AS lifetime_value FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey=o_custkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name, c_nationkey ) SELECT clv.c_custkey, clv.c_name, n_name, clv.lifetime_value, NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY c_nationkey ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC) AS value_tier FROM clv JOIN nation ON clv.c_nationkey=n_nationkey ORDER BY c_nationkey, value_tier LIMIT 100;

WITH clv AS ( SELECT c_custkey, c_name, c_nationkey, SUM(o_totalprice) AS lifetime_value FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey=o_custkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name, c_nationkey ) SELECT clv.c_custkey, clv.c_name, n_name, clv.lifetime_value, ROUND(AVG(clv.lifetime_value) OVER (PARTITION BY clv.c_nationkey),2) AS nation_avg, ROUND(clv.lifetime_value - AVG(clv.lifetime_value) OVER (PARTITION BY clv.c_nationkey),2) AS diff_from_avg FROM clv JOIN nation ON clv.c_nationkey=n_nationkey ORDER BY c_nationkey, diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH clv AS ( SELECT c_custkey, c_nationkey, SUM(o_totalprice) AS lifetime_value FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey=o_custkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_nationkey ), nation_avg AS ( SELECT c_nationkey, AVG(lifetime_value) AS nat_avg FROM clv GROUP BY c_nationkey ) SELECT r_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE clv.lifetime_value > nation_avg.nat_avg) AS above_avg_count, COUNT(*) AS total_customers FROM clv JOIN nation_avg ON clv.c_nationkey = nation_avg.c_nationkey JOIN nation ON clv.c_nationkey = n_nationkey JOIN region ON n_regionkey = r_regionkey GROUP BY r_name ORDER BY above_avg_count DESC;

SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, l_shipdate, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS daily_revenue, SUM(SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount))) OVER (PARTITION BY s_suppkey ORDER BY l_shipdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total FROM supplier JOIN lineitem ON s_suppkey = l_suppkey GROUP BY s_suppkey, s_name, l_shipdate ORDER BY s_suppkey, l_shipdate LIMIT 200;

SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l_shipdate) AS mo, SUM(l_extendedprice*(1-l_discount)) AS monthly_revenue, SUM(SUM(l_extendedprice*(1-l_discount))) OVER ( PARTITION BY s_suppkey ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l_shipdate) ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total FROM supplier JOIN lineitem ON s_suppkey=l_suppkey GROUP BY s_suppkey, s_name, yr, mo ORDER BY s_suppkey, yr, mo LIMIT 200;

SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, l_shipdate, SUM(l_extendedprice*(1-l_discount)) AS daily_revenue, ROUND(AVG(SUM(l_extendedprice*(1-l_discount))) OVER ( PARTITION BY s_suppkey ORDER BY l_shipdate ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),2) AS moving_avg_7day FROM supplier JOIN lineitem ON s_suppkey=l_suppkey GROUP BY s_suppkey, s_name, l_shipdate ORDER BY s_suppkey, l_shipdate LIMIT 200;

SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, l_shipdate, COUNT(*) AS daily_shipments, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER ( PARTITION BY s_suppkey ORDER BY l_shipdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_shipment_count FROM supplier JOIN lineitem ON s_suppkey=l_suppkey GROUP BY s_suppkey, s_name, l_shipdate ORDER BY s_suppkey, l_shipdate LIMIT 200;

SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, l_shipdate, SUM(l_extendedprice*(1-l_discount)) AS daily_revenue, LAG(SUM(l_extendedprice*(1-l_discount))) OVER ( PARTITION BY s_suppkey ORDER BY l_shipdate) AS prev_day_revenue, ROUND(SUM(l_extendedprice*(1-l_discount)) - LAG(SUM(l_extendedprice*(1-l_discount))) OVER ( PARTITION BY s_suppkey ORDER BY l_shipdate),2) AS day_over_day_change FROM supplier JOIN lineitem ON s_suppkey=l_suppkey GROUP BY s_suppkey, s_name, l_shipdate ORDER BY s_suppkey, l_shipdate LIMIT 200;

SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, l_shipdate, COUNT(DISTINCT l_partkey) AS daily_distinct_parts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l_partkey)) OVER ( PARTITION BY s_suppkey ORDER BY l_shipdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_part_count FROM supplier JOIN lineitem ON s_suppkey=l_suppkey GROUP BY s_suppkey, s_name, l_shipdate ORDER BY s_suppkey, l_shipdate LIMIT 200;

SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, l_shipdate, SUM(l_extendedprice*(1-l_discount)) AS daily_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l_shipdate ORDER BY SUM(l_extendedprice*(1-l_discount)) DESC) AS rank_on_day FROM supplier JOIN lineitem ON s_suppkey=l_suppkey GROUP BY s_suppkey, s_name, l_shipdate ORDER BY l_shipdate, rank_on_day LIMIT 200;

SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, l_shipdate, SUM(l_quantity) AS daily_qty, SUM(SUM(l_quantity)) OVER ( PARTITION BY s_suppkey ORDER BY l_shipdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_qty_total FROM supplier JOIN lineitem ON s_suppkey=l_suppkey GROUP BY s_suppkey, s_name, l_shipdate ORDER BY s_suppkey, l_shipdate LIMIT 200;

SELECT n_name, l_shipdate, SUM(l_extendedprice*(1-l_discount)) AS daily_revenue, SUM(SUM(l_extendedprice*(1-l_discount))) OVER ( PARTITION BY n_name ORDER BY l_shipdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total FROM nation JOIN supplier ON n_nationkey=s_nationkey JOIN lineitem ON s_suppkey=l_suppkey GROUP BY n_name, l_shipdate ORDER BY n_name, l_shipdate LIMIT 200;

SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l_shipdate) AS qtr, SUM(l_extendedprice*(1-l_discount)) AS quarterly_revenue, SUM(SUM(l_extendedprice*(1-l_discount))) OVER ( PARTITION BY s_suppkey ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l_shipdate) ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total FROM supplier JOIN lineitem ON s_suppkey=l_suppkey GROUP BY s_suppkey, s_name, yr, qtr ORDER BY s_suppkey, yr, qtr LIMIT 200;

SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, l_shipdate, SUM(l_extendedprice * l_discount) AS daily_discount_given, SUM(SUM(l_extendedprice * l_discount)) OVER ( PARTITION BY s_suppkey ORDER BY l_shipdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_discount_total FROM supplier JOIN lineitem ON s_suppkey=l_suppkey GROUP BY s_suppkey, s_name, l_shipdate ORDER BY s_suppkey, l_shipdate LIMIT 200;

WITH part_revenue AS ( SELECT p_brand, p_partkey, p_name, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey GROUP BY p_brand, p_partkey, p_name ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p_brand ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS brand_rank FROM part_revenue ) SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE brand_rank <= 3 ORDER BY p_brand, brand_rank;

WITH period1 AS ( SELECT o_custkey, COUNT(*) AS cnt1 FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1993-01-01' AND DATE '1995-12-31' GROUP BY o_custkey ), period2 AS ( SELECT o_custkey, COUNT(*) AS cnt2 FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1998-12-31' GROUP BY o_custkey ) SELECT c_custkey, c_name, cnt1, cnt2, cnt2 - cnt1 AS order_change FROM customer JOIN period1 ON c_custkey = period1.o_custkey JOIN period2 ON c_custkey = period2.o_custkey WHERE cnt2 < cnt1 ORDER BY order_change;
